vendors.name: Fortinet FortiGate + FortiGuard/FortiCare
vendors.offering: NGFW appliances with annual FortiGuard security subscriptions and FortiCare support

vendors.name: Check Point Quantum (Spark to 16000+)
vendors.offering: Quantum security gateways with SandBlast/threat-prevention subscriptions and central management

vendors.name: Palo Alto Networks NGFW (PA-400/1400 series)
vendors.offering: NGFW hardware with per-device subscriptions: threat prevention, URL filtering, DNS, WildFire
vendors.pricing: not public; reseller e.g. PA-1410 Advanced URL Filtering 3-year HA subscription $7,295.99

vendors.name: Sophos Firewall (XGS)
vendors.offering: XGS appliances with Xstream Protection bundles, sold via partners and MSPs
vendors.pricing: quote-based via partners; reseller e.g. XGS 116 Xstream Protection 12 months $886.99

vendors.name: SonicWall firewalls
vendors.offering: SMB/mid-market NGFWs with security service renewals sold through partners
vendors.pricing: not public; Gen 6/6.5 renewal SKUs raised up to 20% from May 2025

vendors.name: Stormshield Network Security (SNS)
vendors.offering: European firewalls qualified by ANSSI (France) and CCN (Spain) for public bodies

vendors.name: Netgate pfSense Plus
vendors.offering: Open-source-based firewall appliances and software with paid TAC support
vendors.pricing: appliances from $189; TAC Lite $129/year; TAC Enterprise $799 per install

vendors.name: Tufin (firewall policy management and migration)
vendors.offering: Multi-vendor firewall policy automation, optimization and migration during refresh

paid_market_gaps.gap: Installed-base renewal price hikes trap buyers; replacing a firewall is far harder than cancelling software.
Cross-vendor migration tools are vendor-owned (FortiConverter) or enterprise-priced, slowing switching at refresh time.
Few EU-sovereign, nationally certified firewalls for public bodies; Stormshield claims sole ANSSI Standard qualification.
Opaque quote-only partner pricing makes firewall renewals hard to benchmark for public buyers.

wtp_evidence: Public bodies tender large firewall refreshes (EUR 500,000 Check Point tender); Sophos renewals rose about 10% and SonicWall renewals up to 20%, sold through paid subscriptions.
bundling_note: AWS and Azure sell native cloud firewalls and Netgate bundles pfSense free with hardware, but on-premises perimeter NGFWs for public bodies are not given away.
summary: Crowded, incumbent-dominated market (Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point) bought via tenders. No room for a new firewall; a narrow opening exists for vendor-neutral renewal benchmarking, licence optimization and migration tooling for European public buyers.
